_instructions: Government starter learning paths (Staff, Supervisors, IT, Champions, Agent makers). Audience groups appear in this order on the site. Reviewable starter steps, not assigned training or completion records.

items.title: Start safely with everyday writing
items.expectedResult: Plain-language version keeps every date, requirement and commitment; you checked it against the original.

items.title: Choose the right source and experience
items.product: Work grounding requires the appropriate license and source access
items.expectedResult: Uses only what you supplied; missing owners and dates are marked, not invented.

items.title: Reply to a public inquiry
items.expectedResult: No personal details in the prompt; every fact traces to approved public information; an expert checked anything uncertain.

items.title: Know the rules before your team starts
items.expectedResult: You can explain which data your team may use, and where questions and incidents go.

items.title: Summarize a meeting for your team
items.expectedResult: Decisions and next steps match the notes; nothing is added; owners confirmed before sending.

items.title: Measure a repeatable improvement
items.expectedResult: Actual time includes review and correction; quality and limits are stated honestly.

items.title: Prepare a safe ten-minute demonstration
items.product: Approved Copilot Chat with public or synthetic demo material
items.expectedResult: Demonstrate the prompt after local approval. Show the source boundary, one follow-up, manual corrections and the applicable data rules.

items.title: Know where questions belong
items.product: Existing organizational support and governance routes
items.practicePromptTitle: Route a synthetic access or policy question
items.expectedResult: Distinguish coaching from access approval, policy decisions and incident response.

items.title: Share a useful pattern and honest result
items.product: Approved practice prompt and existing community channels
items.expectedResult: Share non-sensitive instructions, the result, review effort and measured limits with appropriate consent.

items.title: Confirm access and readiness
items.product: Authorized IT review; no platform configuration is changed by this learning list
items.practicePromptTitle: Document readiness checks for a non-production pilot
items.expectedResult: Identify source owners, access boundaries and unresolved prerequisites; do not treat a checklist as completed controls.

items.title: Test the user support journey
items.product: Authorized test accounts and existing support routes
items.practicePromptTitle: Walk through a synthetic missing-access case
items.expectedResult: Separate license, source access, rollout and policy causes; record the support owner without exposing private records.

items.title: Review a proposed internal agent
items.product: Customer-authorized reviewer and appropriate test environment
items.practicePromptTitle: Review agent purpose, sources and permissions
items.expectedResult: Record access/billing prerequisites, positive and negative access tests, support and review dates before publication.

items.title: Choose a permitted agent task
items.path: Build and share a reviewed agent
items.product: Agent Builder or Copilot Studio only where enabled and licensed
items.expectedResult: Define purpose, audience and authoritative sources; exclude consequential decisions and unapproved external actions.

items.title: Test evidence and access boundaries
items.path: Build and share a reviewed agent
items.product: Approved agent test environment with permitted synthetic or public sources
items.practicePromptTitle: Test an answer, missing evidence and denied access
items.expectedResult: Check traceable answers, uncertainty and permission behavior; document connectors/actions and failures for review.

items.title: Submit the agent for CoE review
items.path: Build and share a reviewed agent
items.product: Existing organizational review process; catalog publication does not share or enable an agent
items.expectedResult: Supply the launch link, owner/backup, sources, allowed data, access, support and test evidence; a reviewer decides publication.
